issues.on_page: Public Safety - Contract with Irvington Volunteer Fire Department, Inc. 948,920
issues.issue: This payment passes the district's levy through to a separate nonprofit fire department. The rules' examples put payments to fire boards under 'grants/payments to other entities', which is arguably the better fit.
Bank charges are not professional services. 'debt interest and fees' or 'miscellaneous expenditure' could apply (immaterial; review already set).
